tour.title: The Living Bengal Factory
tour.description: Bengal Earth Lab on the approved Stage II floor, a concept proposal: earth, rural craft, a few living trees, rural art and music, and an honest solar story. This first increment covers the front rooms and the studio.

tour.title: Arrival gallery
tour.description: A banyan bonsai on granite by the glass gate, three stones, terracotta on the check-in desk and terracotta plaques by a rural artist (to be commissioned).

tour.title: Reception and Bengali tea
tour.description: Tea in clay, rural instruments above the console, handloom on the walls, a small fig tree and ghritokumari.

tour.title: Earth and Sun passage
tour.description: The Sun wall shows the energy story with grid and backup included. Concept demonstration, not live factory data.

tour.title: Earth to product
tour.description: Raw material, craft technique, prototype, testing and collection on the plinth: illustrative objects until real samples and records arrive.

tour.title: Living materials
tour.description: Woven jute, hogla, cane, water hyacinth, bamboo and kaisa samples with terracotta tiles; drinking water from a clay kolshi.

tour.title: Negotiation suite
tour.description: Tea in clay at every place, woven samples on wooden trays, a bonsai in the corner.

tour.title: Collaborative studio
tour.description: The only room with daylight: basket prototypes and form sketches on the co-creation table.

tour.title: The sunning shelf
tour.description: Bonsai and tulsi take turns in the daylight of window W10.

tour.title: Designed for a Solar-Powered Future
tour.description: Next increments: the Green Uthan and showroom, the academy and artisan studio, the labs and library.

roomNotes.Z01: In this 3D proposal: a banyan bonsai on granite by the glass gate, three stones, handmade terracotta on the check-in desk and six terracotta plaques by a rural artist (placeholder; to be commissioned and credited). The approved logos and brand wall are unchanged.
roomNotes.Z02: In this 3D proposal: tea in clay cups on wooden trays, rural instruments above the console (ektara, dotara, banshi, dhol; makers to be identified), a small fig tree and ghritokumari, with the handloom pieces of the approved redesign.
roomNotes.Z03: In this 3D proposal: the Sun wall (sun, solar generation, use and storage, operations, with grid and backup shown) and a terracotta earth wall. Concept demonstration, not live factory data: "Designed for a Solar-Powered Future" until measured evidence exists.
roomNotes.Z30: In this 3D proposal: the Earth-to-Product gallery on the plinth (raw material, technique, prototype, testing, collection; the four forms are removed), living materials on the table, drinking water from a clay kolshi (source client-stated; no laboratory results yet) and a Future of Bengal lamp prototype by the boardroom door.
roomNotes.Z08: In this 3D proposal: clay cups at every place and a clay jug instead of glass, woven samples on wooden trays, and a bonsai in the corner by the screen.
roomNotes.Z18: In this 3D proposal: the only room with exterior windows: three bonsai and a tulsi pot take turns on the sunning shelf at window W10, a small fig tree by W09, and basket prototypes, woven samples and sketches on the co-creation table.
roomNotes.Z12: In this 3D proposal: tea in clay cups. The office itself is unchanged in this increment.
roomNotes.Z07: Planned: the Green Uthan (a courtyard-like gathering place with a small tree, stone seats and rural art) and European living, dining, bedroom and hospitality room-sets. Needs the merchandising team to move first (owner decision).
roomNotes.Z06: Planned: the design education academy (20-30 people if the fire capacity allows) and the artisan demonstration studio, with its own entrance from the staff corridor.
roomNotes.Z15: Planned: the living materials library, lit as a jewel box behind the experience-centre glass.
roomNotes.Z16: Planned: natural-materials lab and testing (sink and concrete floor already here).
roomNotes.Z17: Planned: prototype workshop with dust extraction (to be engineered), seen from the showroom through the interior glass.
roomNotes.Z05: Planned: digital export and order centre beside reception.
